title: TikTok Kit project configuration
description: Project-level state for TikTok Kit. Records which MCP data planes are reachable and how much query budget one run may spend. Never holds credentials.

mcp.description: Connection state per data plane. Written by /tk:connect.

maxQueriesPerRun.description: Upper bound on MCP queries a single skill run may spend. Metered vendors bill per query; a free tier can be exhausted in one careless run.

thresholds.description: Per-account overrides of diagnostic thresholds. Keys match entries in diagnostic-thresholds.md.

status.description: unregistered = MCP tool absent from the client; registered-but-empty = tool present but no sources linked; connected = data reachable. The fix differs for each.
